metadata.title: Chip Stock Rebound Comes Undone After Lam Research Stokes Spending Fears<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Chip Stock Rebound Comes Undone After Lam Research Stokes Spending Fears
Just when it looked like the chip stock rebound had room to run, market sentiment whipsawed into Thursday with major names exposed to AI falling across the board. Spending fears are to blame once again.
